settings_bedeutung.end_button_behavior: What happens when the user presses the end call button if they're not on a call. Values: 0 - The end button does nothing. 1 - The end button goes to the home screen. 2 - The end button puts the device to sleep and locks the keyguard. 3 - The end button goes to the home screen. settings_bedeutung.advanced_settings: Is advanced settings mode turned on. 0 == no, 1 == yes
settings_bedeutung.wear_tts_prewarm_enabled: If the text-to-speech pre-warm is enabled. Set to 1 for true and 0 for false. This setting is used only internally.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_use_static_ip: Whether to use static IP and other static network attributes. Set to 1 for true and 0 for false. Use WifiManager instead
settings_bedeutung.wifi_static_ip: The static IP address. Example: "192.168.1.51" Use WifiManager instead
settings_bedeutung.wifi_static_gateway: If using static IP, the gateway's IP address. Example: "192.168.1.1" Use WifiManager instead
settings_bedeutung.wifi_static_netmask: If using static IP, the net mask. Example: "255.255.255.0" Use WifiManager instead
settings_bedeutung.wifi_static_dns1: If using static IP, the primary DNS's IP address. Example: "192.168.1.1" Use WifiManager instead
settings_bedeutung.wifi_static_dns2: If using static IP, the secondary DNS's IP address. Example: "192.168.1.2" Use WifiManager instead
settings_bedeutung.lock_pattern_visible_pattern: Whether lock pattern is visible as user enters (0 = false, 1 = true) Accessing this setting from an app that is targeting VERSION_CODES#M or later throws a SecurityException.
settings_bedeutung.next_alarm_formatted: A formatted string of the next alarm that is set, or the empty string if there is no alarm set. Use android.app.AlarmManager#getNextAlarmClock().
settings_bedeutung.device_font_scale: Default scaling factor for fonts for the specific device, float. The value is read from the R.dimen.def_device_font_scale configuration property.
settings_bedeutung.system_locales: The serialized system locale value. Do not use this value directory. To get system locale, use LocaleList#getDefault instead. To update system locale, use com.android.internal.app.LocalePicker#updateLocales instead.
settings_bedeutung.dim_screen: Whether or not to dim the screen. 0=no 1=yes This setting is no longer used.
settings_bedeutung.min_refresh_rate: The user selected min refresh rate in frames per second. If infinite, the user wants the highest possible refresh rate. If this isn't set, 0 will be used.
settings_bedeutung.peak_refresh_rate: The user selected peak refresh rate in frames per second. If infinite, the user wants the highest possible refresh rate. If this isn't set, the system falls back to a device specific default.
settings_bedeutung.fold_lock_behavior_setting: Control lock behavior on fold If this isn't set, the system falls back to a device specific default.
settings_bedeutung.screen_off_timeout: The amount of time in milliseconds before the device goes to sleep or begins to dream after a period of inactivity. This value is also known as the user activity timeout period since the screen isn't necessarily turned off when it expires. This value is bounded by maximum timeout set by android.app.admin.DevicePolicyManager#setMaximumTimeToLock(ComponentName, long).
settings_bedeutung.screen_brightness: The screen backlight brightness between 1 (minimum) and 255 (maximum). Use android.view.WindowManager.LayoutParams#screenBrightness to set the screen brightness instead.
settings_bedeutung.screen_brightness_mode: Controls whether to enable automatic brightness mode. Value can be set to #SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_MODE_MANUAL or #SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_MODE_AUTOMATIC. If #SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_MODE_AUTOMATIC is set, the system may change #SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS automatically.
settings_bedeutung.screen_auto_brightness_adj: Adjustment to auto-brightness to make it generally more (>0.0 -1.0) bright.
settings_bedeutung.adaptive_sleep: Control whether to enable adaptive sleep mode.
settings_bedeutung.mode_ringer_streams_affected: Determines which streams are affected by ringer and zen mode changes. The stream type's bit should be set to 1 if it should be muted when going into an inaudible ringer mode.
settings_bedeutung.mute_streams_affected: Determines which streams are affected by mute. The stream type's bit should be set to 1 if it should be muted when a mute request is received.
settings_bedeutung.vibrate_on: Whether vibrate is on for different events. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the vibrate. See AudioManager.
settings_bedeutung.apply_ramping_ringer: Whether applying ramping ringer on incoming phone call ringtone. 1 = apply ramping ringer 0 = do not apply ramping ringer Use AudioManager#isRampingRingerEnabled() instead
settings_bedeutung.vibrate_input_devices: If 1, redirects the system vibrator to all currently attached input devices that support vibration. If there are no such input devices, then the system vibrator is used instead. If 0, does not register the system vibrator. This setting is mainly intended to provide a compatibility mechanism for applications that only know about the system vibrator and do not use the input device vibrator API.
settings_bedeutung.keyboard_vibration_enabled: Whether keyboard vibration feedback is enabled. The value is boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.volume_ring: Ringer volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume. See AudioManager. @removed Not used by anything since API 2.
settings_bedeutung.volume_system: System/notifications volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume. See AudioManager. @removed Not used by anything since API 2.
settings_bedeutung.volume_voice: Voice call volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume. See AudioManager. @removed Not used by anything since API 2.
settings_bedeutung.volume_music: Music/media/gaming volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume. See AudioManager. @removed Not used by anything since API 2.
settings_bedeutung.volume_alarm: Alarm volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume. See AudioManager. @removed Not used by anything since API 2.
settings_bedeutung.volume_notification: Notification volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume. See AudioManager. @removed Not used by anything since API 2.
settings_bedeutung.volume_bluetooth_sco: Bluetooth Headset volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume. See AudioManager. @removed Not used by anything since API 2.
settings_bedeutung.volume_a11y: Acessibility volume. This is used internally, changing this value will not change the volume.
settings_bedeutung.volume_master: Master volume (float in the range 0.0f to 1.0f).
settings_bedeutung.input_gain_index_settings: The mapping of input device to its input gain index.
settings_bedeutung.master_balance: Master balance (float -1.f = 100% left, 0.f = dead center, 1.f = 100% right).

settings_bedeutung.alarm_alert: Persistent store for the system-wide default alarm alert. #RINGTONE #DEFAULT_ALARM_ALERT_URI
settings_bedeutung.media_button_receiver: Persistent store for the system default media button event receiver.
settings_bedeutung.auto_replace: Setting to enable Auto Replace (AutoText) in text editors. 1 = On, 0 = Off
settings_bedeutung.auto_caps: Setting to enable Auto Caps in text editors. 1 = On, 0 = Off
settings_bedeutung.auto_punctuate: Setting to enable Auto Punctuate in text editors. 1 = On, 0 = Off. This feature converts two spaces to a "." and space.
settings_bedeutung.show_password: Setting to showing password characters in text editors. 1 = On, 0 = Off
settings_bedeutung.wallpaper_activity: Name of activity to use for wallpaper on the home screen. Use WallpaperManager instead.
settings_bedeutung.time_12_24: Display the user's times, e.g. in the status bar, as 12 or 24 hours. 24 = 24 hour 12 = 12 hour [unset] = use the device locale's default
settings_bedeutung.setup_wizard_has_run: Whether the setup wizard has been run before (on first boot), or if it still needs to be run. nonzero = it has been run in the past 0 = it has not been run in the past
settings_bedeutung.accelerometer_rotation: Control whether the accelerometer will be used to change screen orientation. If 0, it will not be used unless explicitly requested by the application; if 1, it will be used by default unless explicitly disabled by the application.
settings_bedeutung.user_rotation: Default screen rotation when no other policy applies. When #ACCELEROMETER_ROTATION is zero and no on-screen Activity expresses a preference, this rotation value will be used. Must be one of the android.view.Surface#ROTATION_0 Surface rotation constants. Display#getRotation
settings_bedeutung.vibrate_when_ringing: Whether the phone vibrates when it is ringing due to an incoming call. This will be used by Phone and Setting apps; it shouldn't affect other apps. settings_bedeutung.dtmf_tone: Whether the audible DTMF tones are played by the dialer when dialing. The value is boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.dtmf_tone_type: CDMA only settings DTMF tone type played by the dialer when dialing. 0 = Normal 1 = Long
settings_bedeutung.hearing_aid: Whether the hearing aid is enabled. The value is boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.tty_mode: CDMA only settings TTY Mode 0 = OFF 1 = FULL 2 = VCO 3 = HCO
settings_bedeutung.sound_effects_enabled: Whether the sounds effects (key clicks, lid open ...) are enabled. The value is boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.haptic_feedback_enabled: Whether haptic feedback (Vibrate on tap) is enabled. The value is boolean (1 or 0). Replaced by using android.os.VibrationAttributes#USAGE_TOUCH on vibrations. User settings are applied automatically by the service and should not be applied by individual apps.
settings_bedeutung.show_web_suggestions: Each application that shows web suggestions should have its own setting for this.
settings_bedeutung.notification_light_pulse: Whether the notification LED should repeatedly flash when a notification is pending. The value is boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.pointer_location: Show pointer location on screen? 0 = no 1 = yes
settings_bedeutung.show_touches: Show touch positions on screen? 0 = no 1 = yes
settings_bedeutung.show_key_presses: Show key presses dispatched to focused windows on the screen. 0 = no 1 = yes
settings_bedeutung.touchpad_visualizer: Show touchpad input visualization on screen. 0 = no 1 = yes
settings_bedeutung.show_rotary_input: Show rotary input dispatched to focused windows on the screen. 0 = no 1 = yes
settings_bedeutung.screen_brightness_for_als: The screen backlight brightness for automatic mode. Value should be one of: SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_AUTOMATIC_BRIGHT SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_AUTOMATIC_NORMAL SCREEN_BRIGHTNESS_AUTOMATIC_DIM
settings_bedeutung.lockscreen_sounds_enabled: Whether to play sounds when the keyguard is shown and dismissed.
settings_bedeutung.lockscreen.disabled: Whether the lockscreen should be completely disabled.
settings_bedeutung.sip_receive_calls: Receive incoming SIP calls? 0 = no 1 = yes
settings_bedeutung.sip_call_options: Call Preference String. "SIP_ALWAYS" : Always use SIP with network access "SIP_ADDRESS_ONLY" : Only if destination is a SIP address
settings_bedeutung.SIP_ALWAYS: One of the sip call options: Always use SIP with network access.
settings_bedeutung.SIP_ADDRESS_ONLY: One of the sip call options: Only if destination is a SIP address.
settings_bedeutung.SIP_ASK_ME_EACH_TIME: Use SIP_ALWAYS or SIP_ADDRESS_ONLY instead. Formerly used to indicate that the user should be prompted each time a call is made whether it should be placed using SIP. The com.android.providers.settings.DatabaseHelper replaces this with SIP_ADDRESS_ONLY.
settings_bedeutung.pointer_speed: Pointer speed setting. This is an integer value in a range between -7 and +7, so there are 15 possible values. -7 = slowest 0 = default speed +7 = fastest
settings_bedeutung.pointer_scale: Pointer scale setting. This float value represents the scale by which the size of the pointer increases.
settings_bedeutung.touchpad_pointer_speed: Touchpad pointer speed setting. This is an integer value in a range between -7 and +7, so there are 15 possible values. -7 = slowest 0 = default speed +7 = fastest
settings_bedeutung.touchpad_natural_scrolling: Whether to invert the touchpad scrolling direction. If set to 1 (the default), moving two fingers downwards on the touchpad will scroll upwards, consistent with normal touchscreen scrolling. If set to 0, moving two fingers downwards will scroll downwards.
settings_bedeutung.touchpad_tap_to_click: Whether to enable tap-to-click on touchpads.
settings_bedeutung.touchpad_tap_dragging: Whether to enable tap dragging on touchpads.
settings_bedeutung.touchpad_right_click_zone: Whether to enable a right-click zone on touchpads. When set to 1, pressing to click in a section on the right-hand side of the touchpad will result in a context click (a.k.a. right click).
settings_bedeutung.touchpad_system_gestures: Whether to enable system gestures (three- and four-finger swipes) on touchpads.
settings_bedeutung.pointer_fill_style: Pointer fill style, specified by android.view.PointerIcon.PointerIconVectorStyleFill constants.
settings_bedeutung.pointer_stroke_style: Pointer stroke style, specified by android.view.PointerIcon.PointerIconVectorStyleStroke constants.
settings_bedeutung.lock_to_app_enabled: Whether lock-to-app will be triggered by long-press on recents.
settings_bedeutung.egg_mode: I am the lolrus. Nonzero values indicate that the user has a bukkit. Backward-compatible with PrefGetPreference(prefAllowEasterEggs).
settings_bedeutung.status_bar_show_battery_percent: Setting to determine whether or not to show the battery percentage in the status bar. 0 - Don't show percentage 1 - Show percentage
settings_bedeutung.multi_audio_focus_enabled: Whether or not to enable multiple audio focus. When enabled, requires more management by user over application playback activity, for instance pausing media apps when another starts.
settings_bedeutung.locale_preferences: The information of locale preference. This records user's preference to avoid unsynchronized and existing locale preference in Locale#getDefault(Locale.Category). Note: The format follow the IETF BCP47 expression E.g. : und-u-ca-gregorian-hc-h23
settings_bedeutung.preferred_region: User can change the region from region settings. This records user's preferred region. E.g. : if user's locale is en-US, this will record US
settings_bedeutung.camera_flash_notification: Setting to enable camera flash notification feature. 0 = Off 1 = On
settings_bedeutung.screen_flash_notification: Setting to enable screen flash notification feature. 0 = Off 1 = On
settings_bedeutung.cw_bt_settings_pref: The valid values for this key are: 0 (disabled) or 1 (enabled).
settings_bedeutung.auto_launch_media_controls: Controls whether auto-launching media controls is enabled on wearable devices. The valid values for this key are: 0 (disabled) or 1 (enabled).
settings_bedeutung.camera_autorotate: Setting key to indicate whether camera-based autorotate is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.bugreport_in_power_menu: When the user has enable the option to have a "bug report" command in the power menu. Use android.provider.Settings.Secure#BUGREPORT_IN_POWER_MENU instead
settings_bedeutung.custom_bugreport_handler_app: The package name for the custom bugreport handler app. This app must be allowlisted. This is currently used only by Power Menu short press. Use android.provider.Settings.Secure#CUSTOM_BUGREPORT_HANDLER_APP instead
settings_bedeutung.custom_bugreport_handler_user: The user id for the custom bugreport handler app. This is currently used only by Power Menu short press. Use android.provider.Settings.Secure#CUSTOM_BUGREPORT_HANDLER_USER instead
settings_bedeutung.mock_location: Setting to allow mock locations and location provider status to be injected into the LocationManager service for testing purposes during application development. These locations and status values override actual location and status information generated by network, gps, or other location providers. This settings is not used anymore.
settings_bedeutung.bluetooth_name: This is used by Bluetooth Manager to store adapter name
settings_bedeutung.bluetooth_address: This is used by Bluetooth Manager to store adapter address
settings_bedeutung.bluetooth_addr_valid: This is used by Bluetooth Manager to store whether adapter address is valid
settings_bedeutung.bluetooth_le_broadcast_name: This is used by LocalBluetoothLeBroadcast to store the broadcast name.
settings_bedeutung.bluetooth_le_broadcast_code: This is used by LocalBluetoothLeBroadcast to store the broadcast code.
settings_bedeutung.odi_captions_enabled: Setting to indicate that on device captions are enabled.
settings_bedeutung.android_id: On Android 8.0 (API level 26) and higher versions of the platform, a 64-bit number (expressed as a hexadecimal string), unique to each combination of app-signing key, user, and device. Values of ANDROID_ID are scoped by signing key and user. The value may change if a factory reset is performed on the device or if an APK signing key changes. For more information about how the platform handles ANDRO
settings_bedeutung.default_input_method: Stores android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodInfo#getId() of the input method service that is currently selected. Although the name #DEFAULT_INPUT_METHOD implies that there is a concept of default input method, in reality this setting is no more or less than the currently selected input method. This setting can be updated at any time as a result of user-initiated and system-initiated input method sw
settings_bedeutung.default_device_input_method: Used only by com.android.server.inputmethod.InputMethodManagerService as a temporary data store of #DEFAULT_INPUT_METHOD while a virtual-device-specific input method is set as default. This should be considered to be an implementation detail of com.android.server.inputmethod.InputMethodManagerService. Other system components should never rely on this value. #DEFAULT_INPUT_METHOD
settings_bedeutung.default_voice_input_method: The android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodInfo.InputMethodInfo#getId() ID of the default voice input method. This stores the last known default voice IME. If the related system config value changes, this is reset by InputMethodManagerService. This IME is not necessarily in the enabled IME list. That state is still stored in #ENABLED_INPUT_METHODS.
settings_bedeutung.stylus_handwriting_enabled: Toggle for enabling stylus handwriting. When enabled, current Input method receives stylus MotionEvents if an Editor is focused. #STYLUS_HANDWRITING_DEFAULT_VALUE
settings_bedeutung.voice_interaction_service: The currently selected voice interaction service flattened ComponentName.
settings_bedeutung.credential_service: The currently selected credential service(s) flattened ComponentName.
settings_bedeutung.credential_service_primary: The currently selected primary credential service flattened ComponentName.
settings_bedeutung.autofill_service: The currently selected autofill service flattened ComponentName.
settings_bedeutung.content_capture_enabled: Defines whether Content Capture is enabled for the user. Type: int (0 for disabled, 1 for enabled). Default: enabled
settings_bedeutung.secure_frp_mode: Indicates whether the device is under restricted secure FRP mode. Secure FRP mode is enabled when the device is under FRP. On solving of FRP challenge, device is removed from this mode. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.user_setup_complete: Indicates whether the current user has completed setup via the setup wizard. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.tv_user_setup_complete: Whether the current user has been set up via setup wizard (0 = false, 1 = true) This value differs from USER_SETUP_COMPLETE in that it can be reset back to 0 in case SetupWizard has been re-enabled on TV devices.
The prefix for a category name that indicates whether a suggested action from that category was marked as completed. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.enabled_input_methods: List of input methods that are currently enabled. This is a string containing the IDs of all enabled input methods, each ID separated by ':'. Format like "ime0;subtype0;subtype1;subtype2:ime1:ime2;subtype0" where imeId is ComponentName and subtype is int32. Note: This setting is not readable to the app targeting API level 34 or higher. use android.view.inputmethod.InputMethodManager#getEnabledInpu
settings_bedeutung.disabled_system_input_methods: List of system input methods that are currently disabled. This is a string containing the IDs of all disabled input methods, each ID separated by ':'.
settings_bedeutung.show_ime_with_hard_keyboard: Whether to show the IME when a hard keyboard is connected. This is a boolean that determines if the IME should be shown when a hard keyboard is attached.
settings_bedeutung.accessibility_bounce_keys: Whether to enable bounce keys for Physical Keyboard accessibility. If set to non-zero value, any key press on physical keyboard within the provided threshold duration (in milliseconds) of the same key, will be ignored.
settings_bedeutung.accessibility_slow_keys: Whether to enable slow keys for Physical Keyboard accessibility. If set to non-zero value, any key press on physical keyboard needs to be pressed and held for the provided threshold duration (in milliseconds) to be registered in the system.
settings_bedeutung.accessibility_sticky_keys: Whether to enable sticky keys for Physical Keyboard accessibility. This is a boolean value that determines if Sticky keys feature is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.stylus_buttons_enabled: Whether stylus button presses are disabled. This is a boolean that determines if stylus buttons are ignored.
settings_bedeutung.default_note_task_profile: Preferred default user profile to use with the notes task button shortcut.
settings_bedeutung.always_on_vpn_app: Package designated as always-on VPN provider.
settings_bedeutung.always_on_vpn_lockdown: Whether to block networking outside of VPN connections while always-on is set. #ALWAYS_ON_VPN_APP
settings_bedeutung.install_non_market_apps: Whether applications can be installed for this user via the system's Intent#ACTION_INSTALL_PACKAGE mechanism. 1 = permit app installation via the system package installer intent 0 = do not allow use of the package installer Starting from android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES#O, apps should use PackageManager#canRequestPackageInstalls() PackageManager#canRequestPackageInstalls()
settings_bedeutung.location_providers_allowed: Comma-separated list of location providers that are enabled. Do not rely on this value being present or correct, or on ContentObserver notifications on the corresponding Uri. This setting no longer exists from Android S onwards as it no longer is capable of realistically reflecting location settings. Use LocationManager#isProviderEnabled(String) or LocationManager#isLocationEnabled() instead.
settings_bedeutung.location_mode: The current location mode of the device. Do not rely on this value being present or on ContentObserver notifications on the corresponding Uri. The preferred methods for checking location mode and listening for changes are via LocationManager#isLocationEnabled() and LocationManager#MODE_CHANGED_ACTION.
settings_bedeutung.location_changer: The App or module that changes the location mode.
settings_bedeutung.locationCoarseAccuracy: The accuracy in meters used for coarsening location for clients with only the coarse location permission.
settings_bedeutung.locationShowSystemOps: Whether or not to show display system location accesses.
settings_bedeutung.lock_to_app_exit_locked: Whether lock-to-app will lock the keyguard when exiting.
settings_bedeutung.lock_pattern_autolock: Whether autolock is enabled (0 = false, 1 = true) Use android.app.KeyguardManager to determine the state and security level of the keyguard. Accessing this setting from an app that is targeting VERSION_CODES#M or later throws a SecurityException.
settings_bedeutung.lock_screen_lock_after_timeout: This preference allows the device to be locked given time after screen goes off, subject to current DeviceAdmin policy limits.
settings_bedeutung.lock_screen_owner_info: This preference contains the string that shows for owner info on LockScreen.
settings_bedeutung.lock_screen_custom_clock_face: Indicates which clock face to show on lock screen and AOD formatted as a serialized org.json.JSONObject with the format: {"clock": id, "_applied_timestamp": timestamp}
settings_bedeutung.docked_clock_face: Indicates which clock face to show on lock screen and AOD while docked.
settings_bedeutung.logging_id: The Logging ID (a unique 64-bit value) as a hex string. Used as a pseudonymous identifier for logging. This identifier is poorly initialized and has many collisions. It should not be used.
settings_bedeutung.accessibility_button_targets: Setting specifying the accessibility services, accessibility shortcut targets, or features to be toggled via the accessibility button in the navigation bar, or the floating accessibility button. This is a colon-separated string list which contains the flattened ComponentName and the class name of a system class implementing a supported accessibility feature.
settings_bedeutung.accessibility_qs_targets: Setting specifying the accessibility services, accessibility shortcut targets, or features to be toggled via a tile in the quick settings panel. This is a colon-separated string list which contains the flattened ComponentName and the class name of a system class implementing a supported accessibility feature.
settings_bedeutung.wear_talkback_enabled: Is talkback service enabled or not. 0 == no, 1 == yes
settings_bedeutung.global_actions_panel_enabled: Whether the Global Actions Panel is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.hush_gesture_used: Whether the hush gesture has ever been used
settings_bedeutung.manual_ringer_toggle_count: Number of times the user has manually clicked the ringer toggle
settings_bedeutung.charging_sounds_enabled: Whether to play a sound for charging events. Use android.provider.Settings.Secure#CHARGING_SOUNDS_ENABLED instead
settings_bedeutung.charging_vibration_enabled: Whether to vibrate for wireless charging events. Use android.provider.Settings.Secure#CHARGING_VIBRATION_ENABLED
settings_bedeutung.in_call_notification_enabled: Whether the in call notification is enabled to play sound during calls. The value is boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.keyguard_slice_uri: Uri of the slice that's presented on the keyguard. Defaults to a slice with the date and next alarm.
settings_bedeutung.font_weight_adjustment: The adjustment in font weight. This is used to draw text in bold. This value can be negative. To display bolded text, the adjustment used is 300, which is the difference between android.graphics.fonts.FontStyle#FONT_WEIGHT_NORMAL and android.graphics.fonts.FontStyle#FONT_WEIGHT_BOLD.
settings_bedeutung.speak_password: Whether to speak passwords while in accessibility mode. The speaking of passwords is controlled by individual accessibility services. Apps should ignore this setting and provide complete information to accessibility at all times, which was the behavior when this value was true.
settings_bedeutung.contrast_level: The color contrast, float in [-1, 1], 1 being the highest contrast.
settings_bedeutung.long_press_timeout: The timeout for considering a press to be a long press in milliseconds.
settings_bedeutung.multi_press_timeout: The duration in milliseconds between the first tap's up event and the second tap's down event for an interaction to be considered part of the same multi-press.
settings_bedeutung.key_repeat_enabled: Whether to enable key repeats for Physical Keyboard. If set to false, continuous key presses on physical keyboard will not cause the pressed key to repeated.
settings_bedeutung.key_repeat_timeout: The duration before a key repeat begins in milliseconds.
settings_bedeutung.key_repeat_delay: The duration between successive key repeats in milliseconds.
settings_bedeutung.display_density_forced: The saved value for WindowManagerService.setForcedDisplayDensity() formatted as a single integer representing DPI. If unset, then use the real display density.
settings_bedeutung.tts_use_defaults: Setting to always use the default text-to-speech settings regardless of the application settings. 1 = override application settings, 0 = use application settings (if specified). The value of this setting is no longer respected by the framework text to speech APIs as of the Ice Cream Sandwich release.
settings_bedeutung.tts_default_lang: Default text-to-speech language. this setting is no longer in use, as of the Ice Cream Sandwich release. Apps should never need to read this setting directly, instead can query the TextToSpeech framework classes for the default locale. TextToSpeech#getLanguage().
settings_bedeutung.tts_default_country: Default text-to-speech country. this setting is no longer in use, as of the Ice Cream Sandwich release. Apps should never need to read this setting directly, instead can query the TextToSpeech framework classes for the default locale. TextToSpeech#getLanguage().
settings_bedeutung.tts_default_variant: Default text-to-speech locale variant. this setting is no longer in use, as of the Ice Cream Sandwich release. Apps should never need to read this setting directly, instead can query the TextToSpeech framework classes for the locale that is in use TextToSpeech#getLanguage().
settings_bedeutung.tts_default_locale: Stores the default tts locales on a per engine basis. Stored as a comma seperated list of values, each value being of the form engine_name:locale for example, com.foo.ttsengine:eng-USA,com.bar.ttsengine:esp-ESP. This supersedes #TTS_DEFAULT_LANG, #TTS_DEFAULT_COUNTRY and #TTS_DEFAULT_VARIANT. Apps should never need to read this setting directly, and can query the TextToSpeech framework classes for
settings_bedeutung.tts_enabled_plugins: Space delimited list of plugin packages that are enabled.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_watchdog_ap_count: The number of access points required for a network in order for the watchdog to monitor it. This setting is not used.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_watchdog_max_ap_checks: The maximum number of access points (per network) to attempt to test. If this number is reached, the watchdog will no longer monitor the initial connection state for the network. This is a safeguard for networks containing multiple APs whose DNS does not respond to pings. This setting is not used.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_watchdog_on: Whether the Wi-Fi watchdog is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_watchdog_watch_list: A comma-separated list of SSIDs for which the Wi-Fi watchdog should be enabled. This setting is not used.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_watchdog_ping_count: The number of pings to test if an access point is a good connection. This setting is not used.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_watchdog_ping_delay_ms: The delay between pings. This setting is not used.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_watchdog_ping_timeout_ms: The timeout per ping. This setting is not used.
settings_bedeutung.background_data: Whether background data usage is allowed. As of VERSION_CODES#ICE_CREAM_SANDWICH, availability of background data depends on several combined factors. When background data is unavailable, ConnectivityManager#getActiveNetworkInfo() will now appear disconnected.
settings_bedeutung.enhanced_voice_privacy_enabled: Whether the enhanced voice privacy mode is enabled. 0 = normal voice privacy 1 = enhanced voice privacy
settings_bedeutung.tty_mode_enabled: Whether the TTY mode mode is enabled. 0 = disabled 1 = enabled
settings_bedeutung.rtt_calling_mode: User-selected RTT mode. When on, outgoing and incoming calls will be answered as RTT calls when supported by the device and carrier. Boolean value. 0 = OFF 1 = ON
settings_bedeutung.backup_enabled: /** Controls whether settings backup is enabled. Type: int ( 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled )
settings_bedeutung.backup_auto_restore: Controls whether application data is automatically restored from backup at install time. Type: int ( 0 = disabled, 1 = enabled )
settings_bedeutung.backup_scheduling_enabled: Controls whether framework backup scheduling is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.backup_provisioned: Indicates whether settings backup has been fully provisioned. Type: int ( 0 = unprovisioned, 1 = fully provisioned )
settings_bedeutung.backup_transport: Component of the transport to use for backup/restore.
settings_bedeutung.last_setup_shown: Indicates the version for which the setup wizard was last shown. The version gets bumped for each release when there is new setup information to show.
settings_bedeutung.search_num_promoted_sources: The number of promoted sources in GlobalSearch.
settings_bedeutung.search_max_results_to_display: The maximum number of suggestions returned by GlobalSearch.
settings_bedeutung.search_max_results_per_source: The number of suggestions GlobalSearch will ask each non-web search source for.
settings_bedeutung.search_source_timeout_millis: The number of milliseconds before GlobalSearch aborts search suggesiton queries.
settings_bedeutung.search_prefill_millis: The maximum number of milliseconds that GlobalSearch shows the previous results after receiving a new query.
settings_bedeutung.search_max_stat_age_millis: The maximum age of log data used for shortcuts in GlobalSearch.
settings_bedeutung.search_max_shortcuts_returned: The maximum number of shortcuts shown by GlobalSearch.
settings_bedeutung.mount_play_not_snd: Whether or not alert sounds are played on StorageManagerService events. (0 = false, 1 = true)
settings_bedeutung.mount_ums_autostart: Whether or not UMS auto-starts on UMS host detection. (0 = false, 1 = true)
settings_bedeutung.mount_ums_prompt: Whether or not a notification is displayed on UMS host detection. (0 = false, 1 = true)
settings_bedeutung.mount_ums_notify_enabled: Whether or not a notification is displayed while UMS is enabled. (0 = false, 1 = true)
settings_bedeutung.anr_show_background: If nonzero, ANRs in invisible background processes bring up a dialog. Otherwise, the process will be silently killed. Also prevents ANRs and crash dialogs from being suppressed.
settings_bedeutung.voice_recognition_service: The ComponentName string of the service to be used as the voice recognition service.
settings_bedeutung.selected_spell_checker: The ComponentName string of the selected spell checker service which is one of the services managed by the text service manager.
settings_bedeutung.spell_checker_enabled: Whether spell checker is enabled or not.
settings_bedeutung.incall_power_button_behavior: What happens when the user presses the Power button while in-call and the screen is on. Values: 1 - The Power button turns off the screen and locks the device. (Default behavior) 2 - The Power button hangs up the current call.
settings_bedeutung.mirror_built_in_display: Whether to mirror the built-in display on all connected displays.
settings_bedeutung.incall_back_button_behavior: What happens when the user presses the Back button while in-call and the screen is on. Values: 0 - The Back buttons does nothing different. 1 - The Back button hangs up the current call.
settings_bedeutung.wake_gesture_enabled: Whether the device should wake when the wake gesture sensor detects motion.
settings_bedeutung.doze_enabled: Whether the device should doze if configured.
settings_bedeutung.doze_always_on: Indicates whether doze should be always on. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.doze_pulse_on_pick_up: Whether the device should pulse on pick up gesture.
settings_bedeutung.doze_pulse_on_long_press: Whether the device should pulse on long press gesture.
settings_bedeutung.doze_pulse_on_double_tap: Whether the device should pulse on double tap gesture.
settings_bedeutung.doze_tap_gesture: Whether the device should respond to the SLPI tap gesture.
settings_bedeutung.doze_wake_screen_gesture: Gesture that wakes up the display, showing some version of the lock screen.
settings_bedeutung.doze_wake_display_gesture: Gesture that wakes up the display, toggling between Display.STATE_OFF and Display.STATE_DOZE.
settings_bedeutung.doze_quick_pickup_gesture: Gesture that wakes up the display on quick pickup, toggling between Display.STATE_OFF and Display.STATE_DOZE.
settings_bedeutung.suppress_doze: Whether the device should suppress the current doze configuration and disable dozing.
settings_bedeutung.skip_gesture_direction: Direction to advance media for skip gesture
settings_bedeutung.silence_gesture: Gesture that silences sound (alarms, notification, calls).
settings_bedeutung.silence_alarms_gesture_count: Count of successful silence alarms gestures.
settings_bedeutung.silence_timer_gesture_count: Count of successful silence timer gestures.
settings_bedeutung.silence_call_gesture_count: Count of successful silence call gestures.
settings_bedeutung.aware_tap_pause_gesture_count: Number of successful "Motion Sense" tap gestures to pause media.
settings_bedeutung.aware_tap_pause_touch_count: Number of touch interactions to pause media when a "Motion Sense" gesture could have been used.
settings_bedeutung.one_handed_mode_activated: Controls whether One-Handed mode is currently activated.
settings_bedeutung.one_handed_mode_enabled: For user preference if One-Handed Mode enabled.
settings_bedeutung.one_handed_mode_timeout: For user preference if One-Handed Mode timeout.
settings_bedeutung.taps_app_to_exit: For user taps app to exit One-Handed Mode.
settings_bedeutung.ui_translation_enabled: Toggle to enable/disable for the apps to use the Ui translation for Views. The value indicates whether the Ui translation is enabled by the user. Type: int (0 for disabled, 1 for enabled)
settings_bedeutung.ui_night_mode: The current night mode that has been selected by the user. Owned and controlled by UiModeManagerService. Constants are as per UiModeManager.
settings_bedeutung.ui_night_mode_custom_type: The current night mode custom type that has been selected by the user. Owned and controlled by UiModeManagerService. Constants are as per UiModeManager.
settings_bedeutung.ui_night_mode_override_on: The current night mode that has been overridden to turn on by the system. Owned and controlled by UiModeManagerService. Constants are as per UiModeManager.
settings_bedeutung.ui_night_mode_last_computed: The last computed night mode bool the last time the phone was on
settings_bedeutung.ui_night_mode_override_off: The current night mode that has been overridden to turn off by the system. Owned and controlled by UiModeManagerService. Constants are as per UiModeManager.
settings_bedeutung.screensaver_components: The user's chosen screensaver components. These will be launched by the PhoneWindowManager after a timeout when not on battery, or upon dock insertion (if SCREENSAVER_ACTIVATE_ON_DOCK is set to 1).
settings_bedeutung.screensaver_activate_on_dock: If screensavers are enabled, whether the screensaver should be automatically launched when the device is inserted into a (desk) dock.
settings_bedeutung.screensaver_activate_on_sleep: If screensavers are enabled, whether the screensaver should be automatically launched when the screen times out when not on battery.
settings_bedeutung.screensaver_default_component: If screensavers are enabled, the default screensaver component.
settings_bedeutung.glanceable_hub_enabled: Defines the enabled state for the glanceable hub.
settings_bedeutung.dock_setup_state: Defines the user's current state of dock setup. The possible states are defined in DockSetupState.
settings_bedeutung.hub_mode_tutorial_state: Defines the user's current state of navigating through the hub mode tutorial. Some possible states are defined in HubModeTutorialState. Any value greater than or equal to HUB_MODE_TUTORIAL_COMPLETED indicates that the user has completed that version of the hub mode tutorial. And tutorial may be shown again when a new version becomes available.
settings_bedeutung.nfc_payment_default_component: The default NFC payment component please use android.app.role.RoleManager#getRoleHolders(String) with android.app.role.RoleManager#ROLE_WALLET parameter.
settings_bedeutung.nfc_payment_foreground: Whether NFC payment is handled by the foreground application or a default.
settings_bedeutung.sms_default_application: Specifies the package name currently configured to be the primary sms application
settings_bedeutung.dialer_default_application: Specifies the package name currently configured to be the default dialer application
settings_bedeutung.emergency_assistance_application: Specifies the package name currently configured to be the emergency assistance application android.telephony.TelephonyManager#ACTION_EMERGENCY_ASSISTANCE
settings_bedeutung.assist_structure_enabled: Specifies whether the current app context on scren (assist data) will be sent to the assist application (active voice interaction service).
settings_bedeutung.assist_screenshot_enabled: Specifies whether a screenshot of the screen contents will be sent to the assist application (active voice interaction service).
settings_bedeutung.assist_disclosure_enabled: Specifies whether the screen will show an animation if screen contents are sent to the assist application (active voice interaction service). Note that the disclosure will be forced for third-party assistants or if the device does not support disabling it.
settings_bedeutung.show_rotation_suggestions: Control if rotation suggestions are sent to System UI when in rotation locked mode. Done to enable screen rotation while the screen rotation is locked. Enabling will poll the accelerometer in rotation locked mode. If 0, then rotation suggestions are not sent to System UI. If 1, suggestions are sent.
settings_bedeutung.enabled_notification_listeners: Read only list of the service components that the current user has explicitly allowed to see all of the user's notifications, separated by ':'. Use NotificationManager#isNotificationListenerAccessGranted(ComponentName).
settings_bedeutung.sync_parent_sounds: Defines whether managed profile ringtones should be synced from it's parent profile 0 = ringtones are not synced 1 = ringtones are synced from the profile's parent (default) This value is only used for managed profiles.
settings_bedeutung.print_service_search_uri: This is the query URI for finding a print service to install.
settings_bedeutung.payment_service_search_uri: This is the query URI for finding a NFC payment service to install.
settings_bedeutung.autofill_service_search_uri: This is the query URI for finding a auto fill service to install.
settings_bedeutung.skip_first_use_hints: If enabled, apps should try to skip any introductory hints on first launch. This might apply to users that are already familiar with the environment or temporary users. Type : int (0 to show hints, 1 to skip showing hints)
settings_bedeutung.unsafe_volume_music_active_ms: Persisted playback time after a user confirmation of an unsafe volume level.
settings_bedeutung.spatial_audio_enabled: Indicates whether the spatial audio feature was enabled for this user. Type : int (0 disabled, 1 enabled)
settings_bedeutung.audio_device_inventory: Internal collection of audio device inventory items The device item stored are com.android.server.audio.AdiDeviceState
settings_bedeutung.show_notification_snooze: Indicates whether snooze options should be shown on notifications Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.tv_input_hidden_inputs: List of TV inputs that are currently hidden. This is a string containing the IDs of all hidden TV inputs. Each ID is encoded by android.net.Uri#encode(String) and separated by ':'.
settings_bedeutung.tv_input_custom_labels: List of custom TV input labels. This is a string containing pairs. TV input id and custom name are encoded by android.net.Uri#encode(String) and separated by ','. Each pair is separated by ':'.
settings_bedeutung.tv_app_uses_non_system_inputs: Whether TV app uses non-system inputs. The value is boolean (1 or 0), where 1 means non-system TV inputs are allowed, and 0 means non-system TV inputs are not allowed. Devices such as sound bars may have changed the system property allow_third_party_inputs to false so the TV Application only uses HDMI and other built in inputs. settings_bedeutung.sleep_timeout: The timeout in milliseconds before the device fully goes to sleep after a period of inactivity. This value sets an upper bound on how long the device will stay awake or dreaming without user activity. It should generally be longer than Settings.System#SCREEN_OFF_TIMEOUT as otherwise the device will sleep before it ever has a chance to dream. Use -1 to disable this timeout.
settings_bedeutung.attentive_timeout: The timeout in milliseconds before the device goes to sleep due to user inattentiveness, even if the system is holding wakelocks. It should generally be longer than config_attentiveWarningDuration, as otherwise the device will show the attentive warning constantly. Small timeouts are discouraged, as they will cause the device to go to sleep quickly after waking up. Use -1 to disable this timeout.
settings_bedeutung.double_tap_to_wake: Controls whether double tap to wake is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.assistant: The current assistant component. It could be a voice interaction service, or an activity that handles ACTION_ASSIST, or empty which means using the default handling. This should be set indirectly by setting the android.app.role.RoleManager#ROLE_ASSISTANT assistant role.
settings_bedeutung.camera_gesture_disabled: Whether the camera launch gesture should be disabled.
settings_bedeutung.emergency_gesture_enabled: Whether the emergency gesture should be enabled.
settings_bedeutung.emergency_gesture_ui_showing: Whether the emergency gesture UI is currently showing.
settings_bedeutung.camera_lift_trigger_enabled: Whether or not the smart camera lift trigger that launches the camera when the user moves the phone into a position for taking photos should be enabled.
settings_bedeutung.flashlight_available: Whether or not the flashlight (camera torch mode) is available required to turn on flashlight.
settings_bedeutung.flashlight_enabled: Whether or not flashlight is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.face_unlock_keyguard_enabled: Whether or not face unlock is allowed on Keyguard.
settings_bedeutung.face_unlock_app_enabled: Whether or not face unlock is allowed for apps (through BiometricPrompt).
settings_bedeutung.face_unlock_re_enroll: Whether or not a user should re enroll their face. Face unlock re enroll. 0 = No re enrollment. 1 = Re enrollment is required.
settings_bedeutung.sfps_performant_auth_enabled_v2: Whether or not a SFPS device is enabling the performant auth setting. The "_V2" suffix was added to re-introduce the default behavior for users. See b/265264294 fore more details.
settings_bedeutung.screen_off_udfps_enabled: Whether or not the UDFPS device is enabling the screen off unlock settings.
settings_bedeutung.biometric_virtual_enabled: Whether or not both fingerprint and face virtual sensors are enabled.
settings_bedeutung.biometric_keyguard_enabled: Whether or not biometric is allowed on Keyguard.
settings_bedeutung.biometric_app_enabled: Whether or not biometric is allowed for apps (through BiometricPrompt).
settings_bedeutung.mandatory_biometrics: Whether or not mandatory biometrics is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.active_unlock_on_wake: Whether or not active unlock triggers on wake.
settings_bedeutung.assist_gesture_enabled: Whether the assist gesture should be enabled.
settings_bedeutung.assist_gesture_sensitivity: Sensitivity control for the assist gesture.
settings_bedeutung.assist_gesture_setup_complete: Indicates whether the Assist Gesture Deferred Setup has been completed. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.night_display_activated: Control whether Night display is currently activated.
settings_bedeutung.night_display_auto_mode: Control whether Night display will automatically activate/deactivate.
settings_bedeutung.night_display_custom_end_time: Custom time when Night display is scheduled to deactivate. Represented as milliseconds from midnight (e.g. 21600000 == 6am).
settings_bedeutung.display_white_balance_enabled: Control whether display white balance is currently enabled.
settings_bedeutung.screen_resolution_mode: Used by DisplayManager to backup/restore the user-selected resolution mode.
settings_bedeutung.enabled_vr_listeners: Names of the service components that the current user has explicitly allowed to be a VR mode listener, separated by ':'.
settings_bedeutung.vr_display_mode: Behavior of the display while in VR mode. One of #VR_DISPLAY_MODE_LOW_PERSISTENCE or #VR_DISPLAY_MODE_OFF.

settings_bedeutung.kernel_logs_for_: Lines of kernel logs to include with system crash/ANR/etc. reports, as a prefix of the dropbox tag of the report type. For example, "kernel_logs_for_system_server_anr" controls the lines of kernel logs captured with system server ANR reports. 0 to disable.
settings_bedeutung.logcat_for_: Lines of logcat to include with system crash/ANR/etc. reports, as a prefix of the dropbox tag of the report type. For example, "logcat_for_system_server_anr" controls the lines of logcat captured with system server ANR reports. 0 to disable.
settings_bedeutung.max_error_bytes_for_: Maximum number of bytes of a system crash/ANR/etc. report that ActivityManagerService should send to DropBox, as a prefix of the dropbox tag of the report type. For example, "max_error_bytes_for_system_server_anr" controls the maximum number of bytes captured with system server ANR reports. Type: int (max size in bytes)
settings_bedeutung.sys_free_storage_log_interval: The interval in minutes after which the amount of free storage left on the device is logged to the event log
settings_bedeutung.connectivity_change_delay: The number of milliseconds to delay before sending out ConnectivityManager#CONNECTIVITY_ACTION broadcasts. Ignored.
settings_bedeutung.pac_change_delay: The series of successively longer delays used in retrying to download PAC file. Last delay is used between successful PAC downloads.
settings_bedeutung.captive_portal_mode: What to do when connecting a network that presents a captive portal. Must be one of the CAPTIVE_PORTAL_MODE_* constants above. The default for this setting is CAPTIVE_PORTAL_MODE_PROMPT.
settings_bedeutung.captive_portal_server: The server used for captive portal detection upon a new conection. A 204 response code from the server is used for validation. TODO: remove this deprecated symbol.
settings_bedeutung.captive_portal_https_url: The URL used for HTTPS captive portal detection upon a new connection. A 204 response code from the server is used for validation.
settings_bedeutung.captive_portal_http_url: The URL used for HTTP captive portal detection upon a new connection. A 204 response code from the server is used for validation.
settings_bedeutung.captive_portal_fallback_url: The URL used for fallback HTTP captive portal detection when previous HTTP and HTTPS captive portal detection attemps did not return a conclusive answer.
settings_bedeutung.captive_portal_use_https: Whether to use HTTPS for network validation. This is enabled by default and the setting needs to be set to 0 to disable it. This setting is a misnomer because captive portals don't actually use HTTPS, but it's consistent with the other settings.
settings_bedeutung.captive_portal_user_agent: Which User-Agent string to use in the header of the captive portal detection probes. The User-Agent field is unset when this setting has no value (HttpUrlConnection default).
settings_bedeutung.set_install_location: Let user pick default install location.
settings_bedeutung.default_install_location: Default install location value. 0 = auto, let system decide 1 = internal 2 = sdcard
settings_bedeutung.http_proxy: Host name and port for global http proxy. Uses ':' seperator for between host and port.
settings_bedeutung.global_http_proxy_host: Host name for global http proxy. Set via ConnectivityManager.
settings_bedeutung.global_http_proxy_port: Integer host port for global http proxy. Set via ConnectivityManager.
settings_bedeutung.set_global_http_proxy: Enables the UI setting to allow the user to specify the global HTTP proxy and associated exclusion list.
settings_bedeutung.default_dns_server: Setting for default DNS in case nobody suggests one
settings_bedeutung.private_dns_mode: The requested Private DNS mode (string), and an accompanying specifier (string). Currently, the specifier holds the chosen provider name when the mode requests a specific provider. It may be used to store the provider name even when the mode changes so that temporarily disabling and re-enabling the specific provider mode does not necessitate retyping the provider hostname.
settings_bedeutung.private_dns_default_mode: Forced override of the default mode (hardcoded as "automatic", nee "opportunistic"). This allows changing the default mode without effectively disabling other modes, all of which require explicit user action to enable/configure. See also b/79719289. Value is a string, suitable for assignment to PRIVATE_DNS_MODE above. {}

settings_bedeutung.app_ops_constants: App ops specific settings. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "state_settle_time=10000" The following keys are supported: top_state_settle_time (long) fg_service_state_settle_time (long) bg_state_settle_time (long) Type: string com.android.server.AppOpsService.Constants

settings_bedeutung.anomaly_config_version: An integer to show the version of the anomaly config. Ex: 1, which means current version is 1.
settings_bedeutung.anomaly_config: A base64-encoded string represents anomaly stats config, used for android.app.StatsManager.
settings_bedeutung.always_on_display_constants: Always on display(AOD) specific settings This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "prox_screen_off_delay=10000,screen_brightness_array=0:1:2:3:4" The following keys are supported: screen_brightness_array (int[], values in range [1, 255]) dimming_scrim_array (int[]) prox_screen_off_delay (long) prox_cooldown_trigger (long) prox_cooldown_period (long)
settings_bedeutung.sys_uidcpupower: UidCpuPower global setting. This links the sys.uidcpupower system property. The following values are supported: 0 -> /proc/uid_cpupower/* are disabled 1 -> /proc/uid_cpupower/* are enabled Any other value defaults to enabled.
settings_bedeutung.sys_traced: traced global setting. This controls weather the deamons: traced and traced_probes run. This links the sys.traced system property. The following values are supported: 0 -> traced and traced_probes are disabled 1 -> traced and traced_probes are enabled Any other value defaults to disabled.
settings_bedeutung.fps_divisor: An integer to reduce the FPS by this factor. Only for experiments. Need to reboot the device for this setting to take full effect.
settings_bedeutung.display_panel_lpm: Flag to enable or disable display panel low power mode (lpm) false -> Display panel power saving mode is disabled. true -> Display panel power saving mode is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.app_time_limit_usage_source: App time limit usage source setting. This controls which app in a task will be considered the source of usage when calculating app usage time limits. 1 -> task root app 2 -> current app Any other value defaults to task root app. Need to reboot the device for this setting to take effect.
settings_bedeutung.power_manager_constants: Power manager specific settings. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "no_cached_wake_locks=1" The following keys are supported: no_cached_wake_locks (boolean) Type: string com.android.server.power.PowerManagerConstants
settings_bedeutung.shortcut_manager_constants: ShortcutManager specific settings. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "reset_interval_sec=86400,max_updates_per_interval=1" The following keys are supported: reset_interval_sec (long) max_updates_per_interval (int) max_icon_dimension_dp (int, DP) max_icon_dimension_dp_lowram (int, DP) max_shortcuts (int) icon_quality (int, 0-100) icon_format (String) Type: string com.and
settings_bedeutung.device_policy_constants: DevicePolicyManager specific settings. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: das_died_service_reconnect_backoff_sec (long) das_died_service_reconnect_backoff_increase (float) das_died_service_reconnect_max_backoff_sec (long) Type: string see also com.android.server.devicepolicy.DevicePolicyConstants
settings_bedeutung.text_classifier_constants: TextClassifier specific settings. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. String[] types like entity_list_default use ":" as delimiter for values. Ex: classify_text_max_range_length (int) detect_language_from_text_enabled (boolean) entity_list_default (String[]) entity_list_editable (String[]) entity_list_not_editable (String[]) generate_links_log_sample_rate (int) generate_links
settings_bedeutung.battery_stats_constants: BatteryStats specific settings. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "foo=1,bar=true" The following keys are supported: track_cpu_times_by_proc_state (boolean) track_cpu_active_cluster_time (boolean) read_binary_cpu_time (boolean) proc_state_cpu_times_read_delay_ms (long) external_stats_collection_rate_limit_ms (long) battery_level_collection_delay_ms (long) max_history_fi
settings_bedeutung.bcast_fg_constants: Broadcast dispatch tuning parameters specific to foreground broadcasts. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "foo=1,bar=true" The following keys are supported: bcast_timeout (long) bcast_slow_time (long) bcast_deferral (long) bcast_deferral_decay_factor (float) bcast_deferral_floor (long) bcast_allow_bg_activity_start_timeout (long)
settings_bedeutung.bcast_bg_constants: Broadcast dispatch tuning parameters specific to background broadcasts. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "foo=1,bar=true". See #BROADCAST_FG_CONSTANTS for the list of supported keys.
settings_bedeutung.bcast_offload_constants: Broadcast dispatch tuning parameters specific to specific "offline" broadcasts. This is encoded as a key=value list, separated by commas. Ex: "foo=1,bar=true". See #BROADCAST_FG_CONSTANTS for the list of supported keys.
settings_bedeutung.app_standby_enabled: Whether or not App Standby feature is enabled by system. This controls throttling of apps based on usage patterns and predictions. Platform will turn on this feature if both this flag and #ADAPTIVE_BATTERY_MANAGEMENT_ENABLED is on. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true) Default: 1 #ADAPTIVE_BATTERY_MANAGEMENT_ENABLED
settings_bedeutung.ungaze_sleep_enabled: Whether of not to send keycode sleep for ungaze when Home is the foreground activity on watch type devices. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true) Default: 1
settings_bedeutung.network_watchlist_enabled: Whether or not Network Watchlist feature is enabled. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true) Default: 0
settings_bedeutung.keep_profile_in_background: Flag to keep background restricted profiles running after exiting. If disabled, the restricted profile can be put into stopped state as soon as the user leaves it. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true) Overridden by the system based on device information. If null, the value specified by config_keepRestrictedProfilesInBackground is used.
settings_bedeutung.window_animation_scale: Scaling factor for normal window animations. The value is a float. Setting to 0.0f will disable window animations.
settings_bedeutung.disable_window_blurs: Setting to disable cross-window blurs. This includes window blur behind, (see LayoutParams#setBlurBehindRadius) and window background blur (see Window#setBackgroundBlurRadius). The value is a boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.transition_animation_scale: Scaling factor for activity transition animations. The value is a float. Setting to 0.0f will disable window animations.
settings_bedeutung.animator_duration_scale: Scaling factor for Animator-based animations. This affects both the start delay and duration of all such animations. The value is a float. Setting to 0.0f will cause animations to end immediately. The default value is 1.0f.
settings_bedeutung.fancy_ime_animations: Scaling factor for normal window animations. Setting to 0 will disable window animations.
settings_bedeutung.compatibility_mode: If 0, the compatibility mode is off for all applications. If 1, older applications run under compatibility mode. TODO: remove this settings before code freeze (bug/1907571)
settings_bedeutung.emergency_tone: CDMA only settings Emergency Tone 0 = Off 1 = Alert 2 = Vibrate
settings_bedeutung.call_auto_retry: CDMA only settings Whether the auto retry is enabled. The value is boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.emergency_affordance_needed: A setting that can be read whether the emergency affordance is currently needed. The value is a boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.debug_app: Name of an application package to be debugged.
settings_bedeutung.wait_for_debugger: If 1, when launching DEBUG_APP it will wait for the debugger before starting user code. If 0, it will run normally.
settings_bedeutung.enable_gpu_debug_layers: Allow GPU debug layers? 0 = no 1 = yes
settings_bedeutung.gpu_debug_app: App allowed to load GPU debug layers
settings_bedeutung.angle_debug_package: Package containing ANGLE libraries other than system, which are only available to dumpable apps that opt-in.
settings_bedeutung.angle_gl_driver_all_angle: Force all PKGs to use ANGLE, regardless of any other settings The value is a boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.angle_egl_features: Lists of ANGLE EGL features for debugging. Each list of features is separated by a comma, each feature in each list is separated by a colon. e.g. feature1:feature2:feature3,feature1:feature3:feature5
settings_bedeutung.show_angle_in_use_dialog_box: Show the "ANGLE In Use" dialog box to the user when ANGLE is the OpenGL driver. The value is a boolean (1 or 0).
settings_bedeutung.updatable_driver_all_apps: Updatable driver global preference for all Apps. 0 = Default 1 = All Apps use updatable production driver 2 = All apps use updatable prerelease driver 3 = All Apps use system graphics driver
settings_bedeutung.gpu_debug_layers: Ordered GPU debug layer list for Vulkan i.e. ::...:
settings_bedeutung.gpu_debug_layers_gles: Ordered GPU debug layer list for GLES i.e. ::...:
settings_bedeutung.gpu_debug_layer_app: Addition app for GPU layer discovery
settings_bedeutung.show_processes: Control whether the process CPU usage meter should be shown. This functionality is no longer available as of android.os.Build.VERSION_CODES#N_MR1.
settings_bedeutung.low_power: If 1 low power mode (aka battery saver) is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.extra_low_power: If 1 extra low power mode is enabled.
settings_bedeutung.low_power_sticky: If 1, battery saver (#LOW_POWER_MODE) will be re-activated after the device is unplugged from a charger or rebooted.
settings_bedeutung.low_power_trigger_level: Battery level [1-100] at which low power mode automatically turns on. If 0, it will not automatically turn on. For Q and newer, it will only automatically turn on if the value is greater than 0 and the #AUTOMATIC_POWER_SAVE_MODE setting is also set to android.os.PowerManager.AutoPowerSaveMode#POWER_SAVE_MODE_TRIGGER_PERCENTAGE. #AUTOMATIC_POWER_SAVE_MODE android.os.PowerManager#getPowerSaveModeTri
settings_bedeutung.automatic_power_save_mode: Whether battery saver is currently set to trigger based on percentage, dynamic power savings trigger, or none. See AutoPowerSaveModeTriggers for accepted values.
settings_bedeutung.dynamic_power_savings_enabled: The setting which backs the setDynamicPowerSaveHint api in PowerManager. android.os.PowerManager#setDynamicPowerSaveHint(boolean, int)
settings_bedeutung.average_time_to_discharge: A long value indicating how long the system battery takes to deplete from 100% to 0% on average based on historical drain rates. See #BATTERY_ESTIMATES_LAST_UPDATE_TIME for the last time this value was updated. Use PowerManager#getHistoricalDischargeTime() instead.
settings_bedeutung.low_power_trigger_level_max: The max value for #LOW_POWER_MODE_TRIGGER_LEVEL. If this setting is not set or the value is 0, the default max will be used.
settings_bedeutung.always_finish_activities: If not 0, the activity manager will aggressively finish activities and processes as soon as they are no longer needed. If 0, the normal extended lifetime is used.
settings_bedeutung.hide_error_dialogs: If nonzero, all system error dialogs will be hidden. For example, the crash and ANR dialogs will not be shown, and the system will just proceed as if they had been accepted by the user.
settings_bedeutung.dock_audio_media_enabled: Use Dock audio output for media: 0 = disabled 1 = enabled
settings_bedeutung.encoded_surround_output: Set to ENCODED_SURROUND_OUTPUT_AUTO, ENCODED_SURROUND_OUTPUT_NEVER, ENCODED_SURROUND_OUTPUT_ALWAYS or ENCODED_SURROUND_OUTPUT_MANUAL
settings_bedeutung.audio_safe_volume_state: Persisted safe headphone volume management state by AudioService
settings_bedeutung.audio_safe_csd_current_value: Persisted safe hearding current CSD value. Values are stored as float percentages where 1.f represents 100% sound dose has been reached.
settings_bedeutung.audio_safe_csd_next_warning: Persisted safe hearding next CSD warning value. Values are stored as float percentages.
settings_bedeutung.audio_safe_csd_dose_records: Persisted safe hearding dose records (see android.media.SoundDoseRecord)
settings_bedeutung.tzinfo_metadata_url: URL for tzinfo (time zone) update metadata
settings_bedeutung.selinux_content_url: URL for selinux (mandatory access control) updates
settings_bedeutung.selinux_metadata_url: URL for selinux (mandatory access control) update metadata
settings_bedeutung.lang_id_content_url: URL for lang id model updates
settings_bedeutung.lang_id_metadata_url: URL for lang id model update metadata
settings_bedeutung.selinux_status: SELinux enforcement status. If 0, permissive; if 1, enforcing.
settings_bedeutung.debug.force_rtl: Developer setting to force RTL layout.
settings_bedeutung.low_battery_sound_timeout: Milliseconds after screen-off after which low battery sounds will be silenced. If zero, battery sounds will always play. Defaults to @integer/def_low_battery_sound_timeout in SettingsProvider.
settings_bedeutung.wifi_bounce_delay_override_ms: Milliseconds to wait before bouncing Wi-Fi after settings is restored. Note that after the caller is done with this, they should call ContentResolver#delete to clean up any value that they may have written.
settings_bedeutung.policy_control: Defines global runtime overrides to window policy. See com.android.server.wm.PolicyControl for value format.
settings_bedeutung.blocked_slices: A colon separated list of keys for Settings Slices.
settings_bedeutung.zen_mode: Defines global zen mode. ZEN_MODE_OFF, ZEN_MODE_IMPORTANT_INTERRUPTIONS, or ZEN_MODE_NO_INTERRUPTIONS.
settings_bedeutung.user_disabled_hdr_formats: A comma-separated list of HDR formats that have been disabled by the user. If present, these formats will not be reported to apps, even if the display supports them. This list is treated as empty if the ARE_USER_DISABLED_HDR_FORMATS_ALLOWED setting is '1'.
settings_bedeutung.device_config_sync_disabled: Whether or not syncs (bulk set operations) for DeviceConfig are currently persistently disabled. This is only used for the Config#SYNC_DISABLED_MODE_PERSISTENT persistent mode, Config#SYNC_DISABLED_MODE_UNTIL_REBOOT until_reboot mode is not stored in settings. The value is boolean (1 or 0). The value '1' means that DeviceConfig#setProperties(DeviceConfig.Properties) will return false.
settings_bedeutung.enable_back_animation: Whether back preview animations are played when user does a back gesture or presses the back button.
settings_bedeutung.zen_mode_ringer_level: Value of the ringer before entering zen mode.
settings_bedeutung.zen_mode_config_etag: Opaque value, changes when persisted zen mode configuration changes.
settings_bedeutung.user_preferred_refresh_rate: The refresh rate chosen by the user.
settings_bedeutung.hdr_conversion_mode: The HDR output mode chosen by the user. This is one of: android.hardware.display.HdrConversionMode#HDR_CONVERSION_PASSTHROUGH, android.hardware.display.HdrConversionMode#HDR_CONVERSION_SYSTEM, android.hardware.display.HdrConversionMode#HDR_CONVERSION_FORCE.
settings_bedeutung.hdr_force_conversion_type: The output HDR type chosen by the user in case when #HDR_CONVERSION_MODE is #HDR_CONVERSION_FORCE. This is one of: android.view.Display.HdrCapabilities#HDR_TYPE_INVALID, android.view.Display.HdrCapabilities#HDR_TYPE_DOLBY_VISION, android.view.Display.HdrCapabilities#HDR_TYPE_HDR10, android.view.Display.HdrCapabilities#HDR_TYPE_HLG, android.view.Display.HdrCapabilities#HDR_TYPE_HDR10_PLUS The value
settings_bedeutung.network_scoring_provisioned: Whether the NetworkScoringService has been first initialized. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.require_password_to_decrypt: On devices that use full-disk encryption, indicates whether the primary user's lockscreen credential is required to decrypt the device on boot. This setting does not do anything on devices that use file-based encryption. settings_bedeutung.lte_service_forced: Whether user can enable/disable LTE as a preferred network. A carrier might control this via gservices, OMA-DM, carrier app, etc. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.lid_behavior: Specifies the behaviour the lid triggers when closed See WindowManagerPolicy.WindowManagerFuncs
settings_bedeutung.enable_ephemeral_feature: Toggle to enable/disable the entire ephemeral feature. By default, ephemeral is enabled. Set to zero to disable. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.instant_app_dexopt_enabled: Toggle to enable/disable dexopt for instant applications. The default is for dexopt to be disabled. Type: int (0 to disable, 1 to enable)
settings_bedeutung.boot_count: Boot count since the device starts running API level 24. Type: int
settings_bedeutung.safe_boot_disallowed: Whether the safe boot is disallowed. This setting should have the identical value as the corresponding user restriction. The purpose of the setting is to make the restriction available in early boot stages before the user restrictions are loaded.
settings_bedeutung.device_demo_mode: Indicates whether this device is currently in retail demo mode. If true, the device usage is severely limited. Type: int (0 for false, 1 for true)
settings_bedeutung.database_downgrade_reason: The reason for the settings database being downgraded. This is only for troubleshooting purposes and its value should not be interpreted in any way. Type: string
settings_bedeutung.database_creation_buildid: The build id of when the settings database was first created (or re-created due it being missing). Type: string
settings_bedeutung.contacts_database_wal_enabled: Flag to toggle journal mode WAL on or off for the contacts database. WAL is enabled by default. Set to 0 to disable.
settings_bedeutung.autofill_logging_level: Level of autofill logging. Valid values are android.view.autofill.AutofillManager#NO_LOGGING, android.view.autofill.AutofillManager#FLAG_ADD_CLIENT_DEBUG, or android.view.autofill.AutofillManager#FLAG_ADD_CLIENT_VERBOSE.
settings_bedeutung.autofill_max_partitions_size: Maximum number of partitions that can be allowed in an autofill session.
settings_bedeutung.autofill_max_visible_datasets: Maximum number of visible datasets in the Autofill dataset picker UI, or 0 to use the default value from resources.
settings_bedeutung.stylus_ever_used: Indicates whether a stylus has ever been used on the device.
settings_bedeutung.hidden_api_policy: Hidden API enforcement policy for apps. Values correspond to @android.content.pm.ApplicationInfo.HiddenApiEnforcementPolicy
settings_bedeutung.signed_config_version: Current version of signed configuration applied.
settings_bedeutung.clockwork_home_ready: Setting to determine if the Clockwork Home application is ready. Set to 1 when the Clockwork Home application has finished starting up.
settings_bedeutung.aware_allowed: Indicates whether aware is available in the current location.
settings_bedeutung.power_button_short_press: Overrides internal R.integer.config_shortPressOnPowerBehavior. Allowable values detailed in frameworks/base/core/res/res/values/config.xml. Used by PhoneWindowManager.
settings_bedeutung.power_button_double_press: Overrides internal R.integer.config_doublePressOnPowerBehavior. Allowable values detailed in frameworks/base/core/res/res/values/config.xml. Used by PhoneWindowManager.
settings_bedeutung.power_button_triple_press: Overrides internal R.integer.config_triplePressOnPowerBehavior. Allowable values detailed in frameworks/base/core/res/res/values/config.xml. Used by PhoneWindowManager.
settings_bedeutung.one_handed_keyguard_side: In one handed mode, which side the keyguard should be on. Allowable values are one of the ONE_HANDED_KEYGUARD_SIDE_* constants.
settings_bedeutung.multi_sim_voice_call: Subscription Id to be used for voice call on a multi sim device.
settings_bedeutung.multi_sim_voice_prompt: Used to provide option to user to select subscription during dial. The supported values are 0 = disable or 1 = enable prompt.
settings_bedeutung.multi_sim_data_call: Subscription Id to be used for data call on a multi sim device.
settings_bedeutung.multi_sim_sms: Subscription Id to be used for SMS on a multi sim device.
settings_bedeutung.multi_sim_sms_prompt: Used to provide option to user to select subscription during send SMS. The value 1 - enable, 0 - disable
settings_bedeutung.enabled_subscription_for_slot: Which subscription is enabled for a physical slot.
settings_bedeutung.modem_stack_enabled_for_slot: Whether corresponding logical modem is enabled for a physical slot. The value 1 - enable, 0 - disable
settings_bedeutung.new_contact_aggregator: Whether to enable new contacts aggregator or not. The value 1 - enable, 0 - disable
settings_bedeutung.contact_metadata_sync: Whether to enable contacts metadata syncing or not The value 1 - enable, 0 - disable @removed
settings_bedeutung.contact_metadata_sync_enabled: Whether to enable contacts metadata syncing or not The value 1 - enable, 0 - disable
settings_bedeutung.enable_cellular_on_boot: Whether to enable cellular on boot. The value 1 - enable, 0 - disable
settings_bedeutung.max_notification_enqueue_rate: The maximum allowed notification enqueue rate in Hertz. Should be a float, and includes updates only.
settings_bedeutung.show_temperature_warning: Whether to show the high temperature warning notification.
settings_bedeutung.show_usb_temperature_alarm: Whether to show the usb high temperature alarm notification.
settings_bedeutung.warning_temperature: Temperature at which the high temperature warning notification should be shown.

Job scheduler (jobscheduler) commands:
  help
    Print this help text.
  run [-f | --force] [-s | --satisfied] [-u | --user USER_ID] PACKAGE JOB_ID
    Trigger immediate execution of a specific scheduled job. For historical
    reasons, some constraints, such as battery, are ignored when this
    command is called. If you don't want any constraints to be ignored,
    include the -s flag.
    Options:
      -f or --force: run the job even if technical constraints such as
         connectivity are not currently met. This is incompatible with -f 
         and so an error will be reported if both are given.
      -s or --satisfied: run the job only if all constraints are met.
         This is incompatible with -f and so an error will be reported
         if both are given.
      -u or --user: specify which user's job is to be run; the default is
         the primary or system user
  timeout [-u | --user USER_ID] [PACKAGE] [JOB_ID]
    Trigger immediate timeout of currently executing jobs, as if their.
    execution timeout had expired.
    Options:
      -u or --user: specify which user's job is to be run; the default is
         all users
  cancel [-u | --user USER_ID] PACKAGE [JOB_ID]
    Cancel a scheduled job.  If a job ID is not supplied, all jobs scheduled
    by that package will be canceled.  USE WITH CAUTION.
    Options:
      -u or --user: specify which user's job is to be run; the default is
         the primary or system user
  heartbeat [num]
    No longer used.
  monitor-battery [on|off]
    Control monitoring of all battery changes.  Off by default.  Turning
    on makes get-battery-seq useful.
  get-battery-seq
    Return the last battery update sequence number that was received.
  get-battery-charging
    Return whether the battery is currently considered to be charging.
  get-battery-not-low
    Return whether the battery is currently considered to not be low.
  get-storage-seq
    Return the last storage update sequence number that was received.
  get-storage-not-low
    Return whether storage is currently considered to not be low.
  get-job-state [-u | --user USER_ID] PACKAGE JOB_ID
    Return the current state of a job, may be any combination of:
      pending: currently on the pending list, waiting to be active
      active: job is actively running
      user-stopped: job can't run because its user is stopped
      backing-up: job can't run because app is currently backing up its data
      no-component: job can't run because its component is not available
      ready: job is ready to run (all constraints satisfied or bypassed)
      waiting: if nothing else above is printed, job not ready to run
    Options:

cmd_hilfe.media_session:
usage: media_session [subcommand] [options]
       media_session dispatch KEY
       media_session list-sessions
       media_session monitor <tag>
       media_session volume [options]

media_session dispatch: dispatch a media key to the system.
                KEY may be: play, pause, play-pause, mute, headsethook,
                stop, next, previous, rewind, record, fast-forward.
media_session list-sessions: print a list of the current sessions.
media_session monitor: monitor updates to the specified session.
                       Use the tag from list-sessions.
media_session volume:  the options are as follows: 
		--stream STREAM selects the stream to control, see AudioManager.STREAM_*
		                controls AudioManager.STREAM_MUSIC if no stream is specified
		--set INDEX     sets the volume index value
		--adj DIRECTION adjusts the volume, use raise|same|lower for the direction
		--get           outputs the current volume
		--show          shows the UI during the volume change
	examples:
		adb shell media volume --show --stream 3 --set 11
		adb shell media volume --stream 0 --adj lower
		adb shell media volume --stream 3 --get
